topics.title: Autistic burnout: definition, causes and warning signs
topics.scope: What autistic/neurodivergent burnout is (Raymaker, Higgins criteria), its causes (masking, sensory and social load, chronic stress), symptoms such as skill regression and exhaustion, and checklists and scales for self-assessment.

topics.title: Autistic burnout versus depression
topics.scope: How to tell autistic burnout from depression: shared symptoms, key differences (cause, motivation, skill loss, social withdrawal) and why behavioral activation can help depression but worsen burnout.

topics.title: Recovering from neurodivergent burnout
topics.scope: Recovery from autistic/neurodivergent burnout: the two phases of recovery, why plain rest fails, recovery plans and demand reduction, nervous-system tools, sensory inventories, soothing kits and restorative activities by sense, relearning boundaries after masking, deep recovery (unmasking, internalized ableism, grief), and self-advocacy scripts and accommodation requests.

topics.title: Pacing and energy accounting
topics.scope: Managing limited energy with pacing: energy accounting, the boom-bust cycle, traffic-light calendars, activity-or-rest flowcharts, health and pain trackers, and why exercise can make things worse.

topics.title: Internalized capitalism, ableism and self-worth
topics.scope: How internalized capitalism and internalized ableism tie self-worth to productivity and fuel masking and burnout; signs, the inner critic, toxic positivity and self-compassionate alternatives.

domains.domain: Masking, Identity and the Neurodiversity Paradigm

topics.title: Masking, camouflaging and unmasking
topics.scope: What masking/camouflaging is (compensation, masking, assimilation), its cost in exhaustion and burnout, workbooks for spotting it, and how values-based, safe unmasking works.

topics.title: What autism is: the neurodiversity paradigm
topics.scope: Definitions of autism and neurodiversity (Nick Walker), key terms, spectrum models of autism and ADHD, the double empathy problem, and perspective-taking on neurotypical versus autistic norms.

topics.title: Autistic identity, community and disability pride
topics.scope: Autistic identity and acceptance: why 'don't let autism define you' is problematic, community norms (identity-first language, self-diagnosis, rejecting functioning labels), disability pride and the hexagon of autistic needs.

domains.domain: Recognizing Autism and ADHD: Diagnosis and Research

topics.title: Recognizing autism in adults: criteria, hidden traits and late diagnosis
topics.scope: DSM-5-TR autism criteria in plain language, lesser-known adult traits (including first-person accounts of traits one thought one lacked), the broader autism phenotype, PDA, why autism is recognized late, meltdown vs panic attack, and whether a formal diagnosis matters.

topics.title: Differential diagnosis: autism, ADHD and look-alike conditions
topics.scope: How autism and ADHD differ from and co-occur with PTSD/C-PTSD, BPD, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, OCD, panic attacks and selective mutism, with comparison charts and checklists.

topics.title: Reading autism and ADHD research critically
topics.scope: Brain connectivity and genetics of autism, fMRI subtypes, why brain scans cannot yet diagnose psychiatric conditions or neurodivergence, and critical breakdowns of studies and claims (Z944 mouse study, vulnerable narcissism, paracetamol, Ozempic for ADHD).

topics.title: Regulating the neurodivergent nervous system
topics.scope: The neurodivergent nervous system, the window of tolerance, hyper- and hypoarousal, dorsal vagal shutdown, vagal tone, up- and down-regulating practices (breathing, movement, grounding, bilateral stimulation) and calming the nervous system for sleep.

topics.title: Sensory processing, overload and sensory regulation
topics.scope: Sensory overload in autism and ADHD, sensory regulation as the base for emotion and executive function, sensory safety plans and sensory-friendly activities, stimming, and overload mistaken for panic.

topics.title: Interoception, alexithymia and naming emotions
topics.scope: Interoception and homeostasis in autism and ADHD, alexithymia, emotional dysregulation, misattribution of arousal, and tools for recognizing emotions (feelings wheel, intensity scales, own-terms descriptions).

topics.title: Meltdowns and shutdowns
topics.scope: What autistic meltdowns and shutdowns are, how they differ from panic attacks, aggression and selective mutism, how to co-regulate, and how people recover afterwards.

topics.title: Accommodations, self-checks and daily supports
topics.scope: Adapting daily life for autistic and ADHD people: self-check of needs, examples of accommodations, compensating weaknesses through collaboration, food and safe foods, suitable jobs, and AI support tools.

topics.title: Autistic social communication and processing
topics.scope: How autistic people communicate and process social interaction: delayed processing, auditory processing, tone and volume, empathy myths, self-advocacy scripts, direct but kind honesty, and healthy versus limerent attachment.

topics.title: ADHD traits: rejection sensitivity, daydreaming and body doubling
topics.scope: ADHD-specific experiences and tools: rejection sensitive dysphoria, maladaptive daydreaming and hyperphantasia, conflict and emotion overload, body doubling for task initiation, and AuDHD focus quirks.

topics.title: Complex trauma (C-PTSD) in neurodivergent lives
topics.scope: C-PTSD versus PTSD, emotional flashbacks, why autistic and late-diagnosed neurodivergent people are more vulnerable to trauma and PTSD (dual representation model, sensory and stress-system differences), people-pleasing and hypervigilance, trauma-related memory loss, gaslighting in relationships and therapy goals.

topics.title: Medical gaslighting and medical trauma
topics.scope: How dismissive care ('it's psychosomatic') traumatizes people with hEDS, FND and other invisible conditions, including a first-person FND illness story of harmful versus helpful doctor behaviour, how it erodes trust in body signals, and how autism traits collide with chronic illness demands.

topics.title: Anxiety and panic: CBT and body-based coping
topics.scope: Understanding and coping with panic attacks (Oxford CBT booklet) and anxiety, discharging activation before calming, EFT tapping and reducing body tension.

topics.title: The neurodivergent comorbidity cluster and self-help map
topics.scope: Physical conditions that co-occur with autism and ADHD (hEDS/MCAS/POTS triad, sleep, GI, binocular vision dysfunction, MTHFR), a self-help map for neurocomplexity, and body warning signs such as stroke in women.

topics.title: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome and hypermobility
topics.scope: Ehlers-Danlos subtypes and hypermobility spectrum disorder, hEDS diagnostic criteria and Beighton score, symptom questionnaires, comorbidities (GI, venous outflow, dislocations), biomarker research and the situation in Russia.

topics.title: Mast cell activation syndrome (MCAS)
topics.scope: What mast cells do, MCAS symptoms across body systems, risk factors (stress, trauma, infection), links to PMDD and Alzheimer's, treatments such as antihistamines and low-dose naltrexone.

topics.title: POTS, dysautonomia, ME/CFS and post-COVID
topics.scope: POTS and dysautonomia symptoms, heat intolerance and cooling strategies, small fiber neuropathy, ME/CFS and post-COVID with post-exertional malaise, and functional neurological disorder fatigue signs.

topics.title: Talking to doctors and patient self-advocacy
topics.scope: How to get heard by doctors (symptom logs, scripts, second opinions, complaints), the right to refuse advice, who may prescribe psychiatric drugs, peer support versus expertise, and staying resilient with chronic illness.
